freeze.title: Freeze this UTXO
freeze.message:
A frozen UTXO stays in your wallet but is left out of every payment this app makes, so your spendable balance drops by {amount}. Unfreeze it from this list at any time.

Freezing only applies here: if you use this seed phrase in another wallet application, freeze the same UTXO there too.
freeze.messageToken:
A frozen UTXO stays in your wallet but is left out of every payment and token transfer this app makes, so the tokens on it and the {amount} it holds cannot be spent from here. Unfreeze it from this list at any time.

Freezing only applies here: if you use this seed phrase in another wallet application, freeze the same UTXO there too.

send.title: Send this UTXO
send.description: Sends this whole UTXO to the destination address, minus the network fee. No other UTXO joins the payment and no change returns.
send.frozenNote: This UTXO is frozen. Sending it spends the UTXO, which ends the freeze.

consolidate.title: Consolidate BCH UTXOs
consolidate.description: Combine all BCH-only UTXOs into a single UTXO. If a dApp asks you to "consolidate your funds" even though you have enough balance, it means you have too many small UTXOs.
consolidate.usageHint: A dApp may ask you to consolidate when its transaction building or its contract can only take a single input from you. That one UTXO then has to cover the whole amount, no matter how much you hold in total.
consolidate.heldExcluded: This excludes any BCH UTXOs marked as reserved or frozen.
consolidate.alreadyConsolidated: Your wallet already has {status} BCH-only UTXO.

flipstarter.ecPluginCompatible: Cashonize is compatible with the EC Plugin flow.
flipstarter.ecPluginCompatibleDetail: Cashonize produces the same pledge as the Electron Cash plugin, so a campaign's plugin steps are the ones that apply here, and its "Copy details" step gives you the pledge request to paste above.
flipstarter.aliasPlaceholder: How you want to be listed (optional)
flipstarter.commentPlaceholder: A comment to show on the campaign page (optional)
flipstarter.dataPublished: Your name and comment are published on the campaign page.

warnings.notAPayment: A pledge is not a payment. The money only moves if the campaign reaches its target, and until then the UTXO is held back and not part of what you can spend.
warnings.dappActions: While a pledge is open, dApp actions from this wallet may fail, because the wallet will not sign away the pledged UTXO. Use a separate wallet for pledges if you use dApps regularly.
warnings.dappActionsDetail: This applies to WalletConnect and WizardConnect, where the dApp builds its own transaction and can pick the pledged UTXO. CashConnect is unaffected: the wallet picks the UTXOs there, and leaves the pledged one out.
warnings.otherDevices: The UTXO is only held back in this app. Do not spend from this wallet on another device or in other wallet software while a pledge is open, because that can cancel your pledge.
warnings.otherDevicesDetail: Another wallet has no way to know the UTXO is held back, so it may pick it for an ordinary payment. The campaign can then no longer use your signed pledge, and this wallet will only see that the UTXO is gone, not why. If you use this seed phrase in another wallet application, freeze or reserve the same UTXO there too, which most wallets support.

review.title: Pledge info
review.noCampaignIdentity: The pledge request carries no campaign name, description or domain.
review.ownAddressRecipient: One of the recipient addresses belongs to this wallet.

signedPledge.title: Your signed pledge
signedPledge.instructions: Copy this and paste it into the campaign page to complete your pledge. Nothing is sent to the campaign by this wallet.
signedPledge.detail: The campaign cannot use your pledge until you paste this into its page. This wallet never sends it for you.
signedPledge.detailNote: Until you do, the UTXO stays held back and backs nothing. Cancel the pledge to release it.

status.expired: Campaign expired, UTXO still held back

pledges.cannotConfirm: The wallet cannot confirm a pledge was accepted by the campaign.
pledges.cannotConfirmDetail: These records are what you did here, not what the campaign holds. The wallet never contacts the campaign, so it has no way to learn whether your pledge was taken.
pledges.cannotConfirmRecovery: If a pledge was not accepted, cancel it to release the UTXO.

confirm.title: Prepare this pledge?
confirm.message: This sends {amount} to yourself now, and leaves that UTXO out of every payment this app makes until the campaign completes or you cancel. The UTXO is only held back in this app.

cancel.title: Cancel this pledge?
cancel.message: This spends the pledged UTXO back to your wallet, which makes the signed pledge the campaign holds unusable.

alerts.pledgePrepared: Pledge UTXO prepared. Copy the signed pledge below into the campaign page.

flipstarter.whatIsAPledge: The wallet pays itself the pledge amount in its own transaction, holds that UTXO back, and signs it over to the campaign recipients. The signature stays valid when the campaign adds other pledgers, so the UTXO only moves once enough people have pledged.
flipstarter.whatIsAPledgeNote: That preparation transaction is a real transaction with its own fee, paid whether or not the campaign ever fills.

identities.title: Identities
identities.description: The token identities this wallet has the authority over.
identities.whatIsAnIdentity: A token's metadata, its name, icon and description, can only be updated by whoever holds its AuthHead: one specific UTXO that moves to a new outpoint with every update.
identities.whatIsAnIdentityNote: Holding the AuthHead is what makes this wallet the one that can publish new metadata for the token.
identities.updatedElsewhere: Publishing metadata happens outside Cashonize, in tools like CashTokens Studio. This page follows where the AuthHead moved and keeps it safe in between.
identities.reserveNote: An AuthHead this wallet holds is kept out of coin selection, so an ordinary send cannot spend it by accident.
identities.resolving: Looking up where the AuthHeads are...

detected.notification: Found an identity this wallet controls, and held its AuthHead back from coin selection. | Found {count} identities this wallet controls, and held their AuthHeads back from coin selection.
detected.foundAutomaticallyHelp: This wallet's keys created this identity or published its metadata, so its AuthHead was found in this wallet's own history and is now held back from coin selection. Remove it from the list if you would rather it were not.

unnamed.title: An AuthHead this wallet holds
unnamed.status: Held back, identity not named yet
unnamed.help: This wallet's keys published metadata for an identity whose AuthHead carries no token, so the coin says nothing about which identity it is. It is held back from coin selection all the same: protecting it does not wait on naming it.
unnamed.removeMessage: The coin returns to coin selection and an ordinary send can spend it, which ends the identity it is the AuthHead of. It will not be listed again.

identities.listedCount: {count} identity followed by this wallet | {count} identities followed by this wallet

status.carriesTokens: AuthHead held by this wallet, with a reserve
status.notHeld: Watched, the AuthHead is not in this wallet
status.unresolved: Could not look up the AuthHead
status.heldViaKey: AuthHead held through an identity key

statusHelp.held: This wallet holds the AuthHead, so it can update this identity's metadata. The coin is kept out of coin selection, so no ordinary send can spend it.
statusHelp.carriesTokens: This wallet holds the AuthHead and it carries a token reserve alongside the authority. The coin is kept out of coin selection, like any AuthHead.
statusHelp.notHeld: The AuthHead is somewhere else, so this wallet only watches this identity: its publication is shown, but updating it takes the wallet that holds the AuthHead.
statusHelp.unresolved: The AuthHead could not be looked up, so where it is right now is unknown. Anything held for this identity stays held until an answer comes back.
statusHelp.heldViaKey: The AuthHead is locked in a covenant, and this wallet holds the key that opens it. That is authority over the identity without the coin, so the key is what is kept out of coin selection.

reserve.mintingNft: A minting NFT, which creates new NFTs of this category
reserve.transferHint: To transfer this identity, empty its reserve first: the transfer moves the authority, and the supply should not ride along unnoticed.

errors.overReserve: That is more than the reserve holds.
errors.overBalance: That is more than this wallet can spend of this token.
errors.nothingToEmpty: This AuthHead carries no reserve to empty.

reserve.help: Tokens riding on the AuthHead are the category's reserve: issued but not in circulation, and not counted as circulating supply. Everything else of this category the wallet holds is ordinary supply.

transferSteps.empty: Empty the reserve, so the supply stays here.

key.guardHelp: The identity output sits at this covenant address, not in your wallet. The covenant releases it only to whoever presents the AuthKey, which is the NFT this wallet holds.
key.manageHint: This identity is guarded, so updating its metadata and moving its supply are done through the tool that builds the covenant's transactions. Cashonize signs them when it connects.
key.hint: The key is an ordinary NFT and moves like one. Whoever holds it controls every identity it guards.
key.destinationPlaceholder: Token address to transfer the key to

add.categoryHelpWhere: Find it on the token's info in the Tokens tab, or on tokenexplorer.cash.
add.categoryHelpKey: An identity key's category works here too: the wallet derives what it guards and watches those identities.
